  - Prepare meals in advance, eat slowly, limit alcohol, review progress regularly.

  - Adjustable dumbbells (2x, 2–20kg each) or fixed dumbbells (pairs: 5kg, 10kg, 15kg)
  - Resistance bands (light, medium, heavy)
  - Optional: kettlebell (8–16kg), compact adjustable bench
  - Mat and doorway pull-up bar (already owned)

  - 1x weekly structured home cardio session (jumping_jack, high_knees, mountain_climber, jump_rope, butt_kicks, jogging_in_place)
  - Intensity and duration progress over the 12 weeks

FINISHER:
  - 1x weekly fun finisher session (burpee, mountain_climber, jumping_jack, plank) with increasing challenge

MOBILITY:
  - 1x weekly mobility flow (arm_circles, leg_swings, cat_cow, hip_circles, ankle_circles, forward_fold, spinal_twist, child_pose, quad_stretch, chest_stretch)
  - Progresses in reps and hold times over the 12 weeks

  - 2x weekly full body strength sessions (push_up, squat, plank, pull_up, lunge, hollow_hold, side_plank, superman)
  - Volume and intensity increase each phase

  - 6 sessions per week: 2 strength, 1 cardio, 1 finisher, 1 mobility, 1 rest day
  - Progressive overload in all domains
  - Nutrition and equipment guidance included
  - Suitable for small flat, minimal equipment, beginner to advanced bodyweight progression
